# Radial fins as repeating radial profiles

Original synthetic Apache-2.0 fixtures for #307 (item 10), generated by
`tools/make_radial_fin_fixtures.py` with build123d 0.13.0. No customer geometry is used.

`radial_fin_housing.step.gz` follows the construction of a finned motor housing with invented
dimensions: an R50/R46 barrel (Z -31..29), a rear wall, a stator sleeve, six standoffs, wire
and screw holes, and 64 radial box fins 1.4 thick reaching R52.5 over Z -26.5..12. The fins stop
short of both barrel ends, so no face of the part's extremal planes carries the finned outline.
It must give one `repeating_radial_profiles` record (64 repeats, 256 edges, Z -26.5..12)
claiming every fin cap, side and tip, and no `pads` for the four axis-aligned fins.

Controls (R50/R46 tube, 40 long): `radial_fin_tube` has 24 full-length fins (the outline is on both
end faces: the established path, unchanged); `radial_fin_short` has the same fins on Z 6..34
(a record by the new path); `radial_fin_single` one rib; `radial_fin_walls` four radial walls
of different sizes; `radial_fin_irregular` is the short-fin tube with each fin shifted off its pitch;
`radial_fin_notched` has 24 notches cut into the wall (cut into the host, not standing on it).
The last four must give no record.

`radial_fin_hex`, `radial_fin_octagon` and `radial_fin_star` are a prismatic section (hex, octagon,
six-point star) between two round sections whose diameter lies between the polygon's across-flats and
across-corners (the star's hub is smaller than its points). Their caps border the lower and the upper
round section, never one host, so they must give no record.

Two identical fin bands on one tube give no record either: each lower level matches two upper levels, and
a miss is preferred to a guess.
